lessons_used: sign_in, copy changes were consistently helpful, winning 4 out of 5 tests (+3.0% average after noise correction).
adoption, redesign changes were helpful in 2 out of 4 tests (+2.3% average after noise correction), while the remaining 2 showed no clear effect.
finish, new_screen changes generally failed after an initial win, with recent tests showing no clear effect or performing worse (-1.3% average).
home, wait_info, home, notification, sign_in, hint, and adoption, layout changes consistently showed no clear effect across 2 tests each.
home, new_flow and finish, redesign changes failed across 2 tests each, resulting in no clear effect or worse performance.
Predictions remained generally too optimistic compared to noise-corrected results, and evidence remains thin for categories with only 1 test.

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Adoption Selection Cards
candidates.change: Redesign the pet selection screen with interactive visual choice cards and mascot animation preview.
candidates.why: Adoption has the biggest drop-off (70.3% conversion) and 3 support emails reported custom pet rendering/creation confusion.

guard.reason: 'pick_friend.replace.pet_choices[0]': a mascot cannot do the pet_choices job (use ['animation', 'button', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'preview', 'text'])

candidates.title: Single-Account Pet Retention Sign-In Copy
candidates.change: Update sign-in headline and body to highlight using a consistent primary account so pets do not get reset or lost.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (the top issue) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again, and sign_in copy changes have historically won (+3.0% avg).

sign_in.headline: One Account Keeps Your Pets Safe
sign_in.body: Sign in with your main email or social account to keep your pet saved to your profile and easily accessible anywhere.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.body' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Pre-Adoption Pet Profile & Personality Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated pet naming and personality preview screen right before generating the adoption certificate.
candidates.why: The adoption stage takes median 89s and drops 29.7% of users; giving pet ownership identity before certificate generation increases attachment.

new_pet_profile.headline: Give Your Pet a Name & Personality
new_pet_profile.body: Name your companion and select their desktop behavior style before completing adoption.

guard.reason: screen 'new_pet_profile' is not part of onboarding (new screens are named new_..., and may not look like payment, account, sign-up or settings screens)

candidates.title: Explicit Pet Controls & Interaction Welcome Copy
candidates.change: Revise the final welcome screen body copy to explicitly instruct users how to drag, right-click, hide, and talk to their desktop pet.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide the pet.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Right-click your pet anytime to hide or chat, and click and drag to move them around your screen.

guard.reason: Updates home intro welcome copy to explain controls without violating rules.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has 23% drop-off and support email feedback; copy tweaks are low cost with moderate confidence.

candidates.title: Stage Layout Path Selection Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign choose_path into a stage layout featuring high-contrast choice cards for quick decision making.
candidates.why: Choose path step has a high mean duration of 514s despite 8s median, indicating users getting stuck or confused on path options.

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Desktop Render Verification Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a desktop screen coordinate and engine background validation checklist flow during the waiting screen.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on the desktop or the app failing to open during launch setup.

waiting.headline: Verifying Desktop Pet Workspace
waiting.body: Checking screen coordinates and rendering environment before spawning your pet.

guard.reason: Updates waiting screen view while continuing to indicate that the pet workspace is being created.

candidates.score_note: home, new_flow changes consistently failed in past tests (-2.6% average) and demand new screens/release.

candidates.title: Founder Adoption Certificate Badge Incentive
candidates.change: Display an exclusive Founder Pet Badge component on the adoption certificate screen to reward adoption completion.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel (70.3%); an instant visual completion reward encourages completing the step.

adoption_certificate.headline: Complete Adoption & Claim Founder Badge
adoption_certificate.body: Finalize your adoption certificate to unlock the Founder Pet Badge for your desktop companion.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions claiming/unlocking an exclusive badge, violating Rule 3 which forbids mentioning free extras or gifts.

candidates.title: Spotlight Layout Sign-In Focus
candidates.change: Switch the sign-in screen to a spotlight layout focusing key social sign-in buttons cleanly in the view center.
candidates.why: 2 support emails reported sign-in screen stalling or failing to appear, and sign_in step optimization consistently improves retention.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save Your Pet Profile
sign_in.body: Connect your account in one click to sync and protect your pet.

guard.reason: Redesigns sign-in screen layout while retaining sign-in job.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in step drop-off is small (13.5%) and layout changes show modest or mixed historical performance.

candidates.title: Instant Starter vs Custom Pet Path Copy
candidates.change: Update path selection copy to clearly contrast instantaneous starter pet adoption against custom pet creation.
candidates.why: Choose path drop-off is 18.3% and mean time is 514s; set clear speed expectations for users who want an instant pet.

choose_path.headline: Adopt Immediately or Craft a Custom Pet
choose_path.body: Pick a ready companion to launch instantly on your desktop, or customize your own pet step by step.

guard.reason: Updates choose_path copy while maintaining options for both adopting and creating a custom pet.

candidates.score_note: Addressing high time spent (514s) and drop-off (18.3%) with low-cost copy updates.

candidates.title: Interactive Controls Cheat-Sheet Welcome Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign home_intro into a two-column view pairing a pet animation preview with a desktop interaction checklist.
candidates.why: 7 emails across support themes involve desktop misbehavior and unclear pet controls post-onboarding.

guard.reason: replacement for 'home_intro.home_welcome' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'] with real words

adoption, redesign changes were helpful in 2 out of 4 tests (+2.3% average after noise correction), while the other 2 showed no clear effect.
finish, new_screen changes failed to sustain early success, with later tests showing no clear effect or performing worse (-1.3% average).
home, wait_info, home, notification, sign_in, hint, and adoption, layout changes consistently showed no clear effect across 2 tests each.
